summary: Depth mode on an NFO future: one book level, the open interest packet, day OHLC and the last trade; OI 1500 in the Depth frame, the four levels not yet received padded.

notes: The web publishes every subscription from its packet stores every 500 ms (motilal_adapter.py _poll_market_data); web.json holds the poll after each push, the desktop sends a frame when a packet changes what a subscription reports.
NFO registers as exchange NSEFO, segment D: wire character N, as NSE cash.

deviations.reason: The desktop sends each book level as a Depth frame before the instrument's first trade, with LTP 0.0 and no quote fields (feed::bridge NO_QUOTE_YET); the web publishes Depth only once a quote and at least one book level have arrived. Gate the first Depth frame on both, as for RB-09.

Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (lead rule 2026-11-09): Motilal's web adapter puts the subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full).

The desktop sends its receipt time as ltt: Motilal's packets carry no trade time either side reads (the packet header's time is undocumented and unused), and the web sends no ltt. A receipt time is not a trade time (lead decision 2026-11-09): mark the last trade time absent.

Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (lead rule 2026-11-09): Motilal's web Quote dict names the last traded quantity ltq only; the desktop sends the canonical last_quantity and ltq beside it with the same value (feed::dialect, WS-05).

Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (lead rule 2026-11-09): Motilal's web Depth dict has no last traded quantity; the desktop sends ltq beside last_quantity in Depth frames as in Quote frames (feed::dialect sends the aliases in both modes).

Follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (lead rule 2026-11-09): Motilal's web Depth dict leaves out the average price its Quote dict sends; the desktop's Depth frame carries every quote field of the instrument's latest tick (feed::bridge::depth_update).
Motilal's packets carry no book totals; the desktop sends 0, the web leaves the total out. Mark the totals absent.

No circuit packet has arrived: the web sends 0 (quote.get('upper_circuit', 0)), an invented limit; the desktop's carrier drops circuits altogether (audit C06). Once the carrier has them, a limit never received is left out and this becomes a web defect.

Four book levels have not arrived. Both sides pad them to five; the web pads with integer zeros ({"price": 0, ...}), the desktop with 0.0. Whether to pad as the web does, in its number types, or send only the levels received (no padded book) is a lead decision.
